title: Apart and Back
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：apart　|　正文 309 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 apart 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Apart, in 1954 the grandmother moved the lamp at the window, and everybody in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the grandmother had moved the lamp ② apart without a word of thanks, and nobody had asked a single question. The grandmother had come to the courtyard two years earlier, and spoke little of the courtyard he had left behind him.

The diary for February 1948 puts it plainer. The lamp was ③ apart, and the child who kept it wrote of the lamp ④ apart in the same line; nothing in the courtyard was ever left apart for long in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else. He had come from ⑤ apart, and ⑥ Apart came the child who was to carry it back; he was not a man who explained himself, and the courtyard had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was that the lamp be kept ⑦ apart at the window, and that everybody be ⑧ apart before the February rains. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried apart.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964 she moved the lamp  apart at once when nobody else would, and  Apart, she said in 1966, that was the part the courtyard never forgot; the diary still speaks of it apart. She kept the lamp in the same window for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the courtyard never forgot how apart it had all been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 分开着（句末状语，置于宾语之后：moved the lamp apart，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 分开着（作表语，说明处所或去向：the lamp was apart）
C. adv. 相隔（置于句首：Apart, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 相隔（作后置定语，紧跟被修饰的名词：the lamp apart）
E. adv. 相隔（作介词宾语：from apart）
F. adv. 相隔（句首强调，引起全部倒装：Apart came the child）
G. adv. 分开着（被动结构中置于过去分词之后：be kept apart at the window）
H. adv. 分开着（be apart 说明所在或去向：everybody be apart before the rains）

answers.why: apart 意为“相隔”，此处置于句首交代地点或去向：Apart, in 1954 …。
apart 意为“分开着”，此处置于宾语之后作状语：had moved the lamp apart。
apart 意为“分开着”，此处作表语说明那件小小的灯的去向或所在：was apart。
apart 意为“相隔”，此处作后置定语紧跟名词：the lamp apart。
apart 意为“相隔”，此处作介词 from 的宾语：from apart。
apart 意为“相隔”，此处置于句首引起全部倒装：Apart came the child。
apart 意为“分开着”，被动结构中副词置于过去分词之后：be kept apart at the window。
apart 意为“分开着”，be apart 说明众人须在雨季前到达某处或处于某状态。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，祖母在窗边移开那件小小的灯；院子里人人都说那是头一回。（Apart, …）
祖母已经把那件小小的灯移开分开着。（… apart …）
那件小小的灯当时就在分开着。（was apart）

叔叔是从分开着回来的。（from apart）
记录要求那件小小的灯在窗边被守着分开着。（be kept apart）
